note: Generated by scripts/analyze_cries.py. Every file is resampled to 16000 Hz first: the corpus spans fifteen sample rates from 8,000 to 48,000 Hz, and a mel filterbank built over each file's own Nyquist would make a similarity search partly measure which encoder produced the file. 16 kHz is chosen because 98.2% of the measured spectral energy sits below it. Peaks are deliberately NOT clamped -- 25.ogg decodes to a maximum sample of 1.0391, which is legal Vorbis and is a property of the file rather than of this script. No similarity matrix is stored: 1,025 squared floats is 4 MB, and the browser multiplies these rows on demand instead.
